pr_title: Enable Mark as Watched in all the other playlist fragments.
pr_comment: Just a note: while testing this, I found that when I tapped "Mark as Watched" in several of the fragments, it did not immediately update. These same fragments also do not immediately update their visual status when you watch a video the regular way, so I didn't attempt to fix the reactivity in this pull request.

review_comment: Yeah, I didn't think to look for an `upsert` method the first time. XD
